flags.name: Flag 1
flags.description:
<s1-nav>From the left hand side, under the Analytics tab, go to HTTP Traffic. Under Referers you can see the websites that are linked to the resource being requested.</s1-nav>

The HTTP Traffic page allows us to review incoming HTTP traffic for all domains connected to our Cloudflare site.
 
<s1-flag example="domain.soledrop.co">The flag is the site with the most amount of requests. </s1-flag>

flags.name: Flag 2
flags.description:
<s1-nav>Go to the shop.soledrop.co website to find this flag.</s1-nav>

The targeted site has a status page. Let's find out why Cloudflare was logging so much activity for this site.
 
<s1-flag example="Ransomware">The flag is the attack pattern the site detected. </s1-flag>

flags.name: Flag 3
flags.description:
Cloudflare uses Bot Scores to measure the likelihood that an incoming web request is operated by an automated bot rather than a human. A bot score of 1 indicates the highest probability of bot activity, while a bot score of 99 indicates human activity.
 
<s1-flag example="50">The flag is bot score attributed to the activity on shop.soledrop.co. </s1-flag>
